reference.source: Paniker's Textbook of Medical Parasitology 8th Ed + Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic maps; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Septate acute is Aspergillus; aseptate right is mucor
Black turbinate in DKA: knife plus ampho
Bleeding white plaques in AIDS: candida
reference.pathophysiology: Angioinvasion infarcts sinuses and lungs while galactomannan sheds from growing walls; capsular glucuronoxylomannan blocks phagocytosis raising intracranial pressure, and Pneumocystis DHFR succumbs to trimethoprim blockade.
additionalDifferentials: Aspergillus versus mucor by septation and drug
Candida versus crypto by germ tube and capsule
Pneumocystis versus CMV pneumonia by LDH and inclusions
additionalInvestigations: KOH with culture and galactomannan in neutropenia
India ink with CrAg and opening pressure in AIDS headache
Silver stain with LDH in ground glass hypoxia
